en: I wish to make a purchase.
Greetings, $C.  Be wary as you travel east toward The Bulwark.  Recent surveillance reports indicate increased Scourge activity in that area, so exercise caution.
Kiss me.
Where is Elder Windtotem?
I can travel faster on my own from here, $n. Meet Jessir Moonbow near Ashenvale. She should be with the druids of the Emerald Circle. She'll tell you what to do next. Thank you so much for your help!
Whew! I think I ate too much. Need to loosen my belt a few notches.
Nope, didn't leave the fossil back here!
I can not train you, young one.
The burning of the Wickerman will begin in fifteen minutes!  Come to the festival - located just west of the Undercity - and celebrate Hallow's End and our liberation from the Scourge!
Many think the staff an inferior weapon. I challenge any who think so to prove their strength against my staff.
Interesting... continue, John.
%s begins the ritual.
Hey, Rocknot!
Take that you mangy Harpy! Hyaa!
This orchard is now as barren and lifeless as my rotting shell. Once these trees bloomed with fruit but now there is only rot.
I'll patrol the pass leading up to Frostwolf Keep. Just give me the word and I'll take flight, Commander.
First Aid may not make up for a priest's healing, but it's handy in a pinch.  I recommend ye go talk to Thamner in the Thunderbrew Distillery and learn what ye can.
Travel to Orgrimmar, to the Valley of Honor. There she lives with her husband and two daughters. All of them are smiths of great skill, but the spirits tell me that she will best guide your learning.
What do you think you accomplish from this, fool? Even now, the Blackrock armies make preparations to destroy your world.
As you wish, Vaelan.

Years of quality breeding techniques and plenty of care allow me the privilege of showing you these horses!  Please, take your time as you consider them for your mount.  A horse is a companion for the ages, friend.  Don't sell yourself short - get your steed here today!
Defilers!
Ah, very good. I am satisfied that you are a worthy student. Now, your training with me may begin...
Have fun in Booty Bay, $n!
Where to go? What to do? So many choices that all end in pain, end in death.
Clean this place up! We will not live in such squalor.
Ah, here at last! It's going to feel so good to get rid of these barrels.
What are the Paragons of Power?
Greetings, adventurer.
Teacher, when are we gonna see the sparkly Mage Tower?
Feralas - Screecher Spirit - On Quest Default Greeting

An excellent question! We have many things for sale here at the faire. If you are interested in food and drink, then head over to Stamp and Sylannia's booth. My favorite is the Darkmoon Special Reserve.

If you'd rather purchase something more exotic, then Lhara may have just the thing for you. She specializes in rarities from all over the world.

And then there is Flik running around here somewhere. If you can grab him he sells balls for throwing and frogs to keep as pets.
$n claims the blacksmith!  If left unchallenged, the Horde will control it in 1 minute!
I'm gonna' enjoy killin' these slack-jawed daffodils!
Hmm, I guess I can take on another student. Well, don't just stand there. Tell me what you're looking to learn.
I knew of another like you once... His name was Vol'jin. You are a rare breed, my friend.
YAW! Er, to the front lines with you!
Fleeing will do you no good, mortals!
Rin'ji is being attacked!
Grrrr! Idiots!

Hi there, $c! With the Ahn'Qiraj War drawing near, our preparations here are in full swing. I'm in charge of thick leather collections. It's a fine day for gathering thick leather, don't ya think? I got my stacks here and it looks like we've got $2069w right now. Our magic number is $2071w. Want to help out?
You outsiders will pay for encroaching on our land!
I'd like to train.
